header: Step 49b. When a question names departments BY NAME AND CODE -- "REFRACTORY (code 86000) and COKE OVEN REFRACTORY (code 86600)", which is exactly what the "Which department do you mean?" boxes (step 49a, departmentAsk.ts) write -- the person has ALREADY decided: I answer with those rows, no more and no fewer. Live, 25 Oct 2026 00:57: for that very question the screen showed department_id IN (46, 258) = REFRACTORY and REFRACTORY (OFFICE) (COKE OVEN REFRACTORY is id 92): 20 people for the wrong pair. The terminal log says why: "department family repaired without a second model call" -- the step 48a REPAIR (repairFamilies) saw the word REFRACTORY, took the REFRACTORY family (46, 258) and wrote it over the SQL, whatever the model had written: it turns even the RIGHT SQL, IN (46, 92), into IN (46, 258). The family logic knows nothing of the row the person ticked. So, when a question carries "(code N)" markers, this is what I do:
- the rows they name are found by CODE and NAME together (two rows can share a code: 103 is P.R.O. and LAW);

- the SQL must select exactly those rows (checkNamedRows); when it is wrong, I mend the first department_id / department_code IN (...) list at once, with no second model call (repairNamedRows, the same mending as step 48a); when it cannot be mended with certainty (a LIKE on the name ...) I send the model back with the exact ids;
- the family logic of step 45b / 48a is NOT used for such a question: it would widen "REFRACTORY (code 86000)" to the whole REFRACTORY family, against the person's choice.
A question with no marker goes the old way, unchanged (checkDepartments / repairDepartments below choose).

symbols.name: namedRows
symbols.sig: export function namedRows(question: string, departments: DepartmentRow[]): DepartmentRow[]
doc: Returns the department rows a question names by name and code ("REFRACTORY (OFFICE) (code 86030)"); empty when it names none.

symbols.name: checkNamedRows
symbols.sig: export function checkNamedRows(question: string, sql: string, departments: DepartmentRow[]): string | null
doc: Returns a sentence for the model when its SQL does not select exactly the rows the question names; null when it does (or when the question names none).

symbols.name: repairNamedRows
symbols.sig: export function repairNamedRows(question: string, sql: string, departments: DepartmentRow[]): string | null
doc: Returns the SQL mended to select exactly the named rows. It returns null when nothing needs mending, or when the mistake cannot be mended with certainty (no department_id / department_code IN (...) to put the ids into).

symbols.name: checkDepartments
symbols.sig: export function checkDepartments(question: string, sql: string, departments: DepartmentRow[]): string | null
doc: This is what the pipeline calls: I use the named rows when the question carries "(code N)" markers, and the department family logic otherwise.

symbols.name: repairDepartments
symbols.sig: export function repairDepartments(question: string, sql: string, departments: DepartmentRow[]): string | null
